status: No unresolved blocking findings in reviewed draft lifecycle, account isolation, selected draft callbacks, or reply/forward preservation.
scope: Independent review of root-authored native/EWS hosts, draft chooser and offline integration. Storage catalog was authored by this reviewer; its independent review and comprehensive validation are recorded separately by validation_setup.

findings.problem: A redundant load after selecting a draft could fail while the host retained the old draft, allowing a later autosave to overwrite the newly selected draft. Closing after deleting the selected draft had the corresponding resurrection risk.
findings.fix: Hosts adopt the chooser-returned snapshot directly. A post-dialog restore failure invalidates the owner and in-memory draft, then awaits close before controls resume. Failure before opening the chooser keeps the current in-memory draft.
findings.tests: Both native and EWS: selected snapshot bypasses injected next-read failure; selected draft deletion followed by read failure closes owner and next compose reopens safely.

findings.problem: Restore validated account only for the optional Outbox capability. A catalog-only implementation could be adopted for a different account.
findings.fix: Validate StudioMailDraftCatalog.account independently before load or adoption, and close rejected owners.
findings.tests: Both native and EWS use a real-SQLite catalog-only proxy with a foreign reported account; load count remains zero and retained drafts stay intact.

additional_verified_behaviors: Retained autosave callbacks are rejected after selected draft A to B to A transitions in both hosts.
Reply and attachment-forward preserve two existing drafts, isolate submission uncertainty, and create a third independently persisted draft in both hosts.
Attachment forwarding preserves exact bytes and starts with empty recipients and no inherited reply thread.
Read-only EWS providers can edit and save local drafts; send and queue controls remain unavailable.
Legacy single-store interface is unchanged; no multi-draft requirement is imposed on old test fakes.
Selected-draft Outbox transfer remains bound to source draft ID/revision; clear and enqueue retire the selection epoch.
